Class InventoryContext.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.github.kaivian.klibrary.inventory.api.InventoryContext.Builder
Enclosing class:
InventoryContext
public static final class InventoryContext.Builder extends Object
Builder for constructing InventoryContext instances.

All setters return this for method chaining. The builder internally manages an ExecutionContext.Builder for the shared context data.
